content.value: A simply supported beam of a span of 16 ft carries a uniformly distributed (25) load of 1.5 kip/ft including its own weight. The beam is to be designed with reinforced concrete having rectangular cross section. Design the beam by WSD method for the following data: $t _ { s } = 1 8$ ksi, $t _ { \mathrm { c } } ^ { \prime } = 2$ ksi , $R = 1 6 6$
